versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Group Expense Settler.
- Splits group expenses fairly with support for equal or weighted shares, including non-even splits and shared vs personal items.
- Computes the minimum number of money transfers (min-cash-flow algorithm) to settle all debts.
- Provides a fairness audit: see what each person paid, their fair share, and their net position.
- Supports ledger input (payer, amount, participants), weighted splits, JSON export, and audit-friendly output.
- Suitable for trips, roommates, clubs, and other shared expense scenarios without dedicated apps.
